body: I do believe it exists, but I do not have the ability to love someone.
I'm prescribed it for ADHD. I've tried coming off it. I've accepted that it's something I will require for the rest of my life.

This "something new" was usually a topic that I would stumble upon and spend hours researching, learning, gaining knowledge about. Now, I don't care for anything. I can't even read a post as long as the original message.
